module.description: The import module (`solid-js`, `node:fs`), `lib` for TypeScript's built-in lib.*.d.ts, `global` for a bare global, or a Python package.

name.description: An exported name (`createSignal`). A trailing `*` matches a prefix.

member.description: `Type.method` for a method on an instance (`Session.get`, `Array.find`). A trailing `*` matches a prefix.

result.description: For a `terminal`: the terminal is not this call but a call of what it returns (`call`, as `useNavigate`'s `navigate`), or of the tuple element it returns at that index (`1`).

settles.description: For `consumes`: the call makes a promise that only rejects, with its first argument (`Promise.reject`).

flows.description: For `calls-back`, `wraps`, `passes-through` and `slot` (required there, and only there): where the call moves values, as access paths (`framework-flows.ts` reads them; `slots.ts` for a `slot`, whose `Argument[0]` is the props: `Argument[0].Member[each].ArrayElement -> Argument[0].Member[children].Parameter[0]`). A `calls-back` row with no flow that touches `ReturnValue` has no value (`useEffect`).

items.description: `<input> -> <output>`: the value at the input path reaches the output path. An optional ` : test` says the output holds a test of the input (a boolean), not the input. A path is a root (`Argument[n]`, `Argument[n..]`, `Argument[this]`, `ReturnValue`) and then steps (`Parameter[n]`, `Parameter[n..]`, `ReturnValue`, `Member[name]`, `Awaited`, `Awaited[error]`, `ArrayElement`), as CodeQL's models-as-data write them: `Argument[0].Member[queryFn].ReturnValue -> ReturnValue.Member[data]`.

variant.description: For a `slot`: other flows when the occurrence sets a boolean attribute (`<Show keyed>` hands its child the value, not an accessor of it). An occurrence that sets it to a value no reader can decide takes neither.

items.description: `<input> -> <output>`: the value at the input path reaches the output path. An optional ` : test` says the output holds a test of the input (a boolean), not the input. A path is a root (`Argument[n]`, `Argument[n..]`, `Argument[this]`, `ReturnValue`) and then steps (`Parameter[n]`, `Parameter[n..]`, `ReturnValue`, `Member[name]`, `Awaited`, `Awaited[error]`, `ArrayElement`), as CodeQL's models-as-data write them: `Argument[0].Member[queryFn].ReturnValue -> ReturnValue.Member[data]`.

flows.description: The flows that replace the row's `flows` when the occurrence sets it.

makes.description: For a `slot`: what the component makes itself and hands a function it calls, which no argument supplies (`Argument[0].Member[children].Parameter[1]` `For`'s index accessor, `Argument[0].Member[fallback].Parameter[0]` the error an `ErrorBoundary` caught).

items.description: One access path, as a `flows` entry writes either side: `ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]`.

init.description: For a `cell`: the paths whose value seeds the call's one state (`Argument[0]`; `Argument[0].ReturnValue` when a function initial value is called; `Argument[1].ReturnValue.Awaited` for a fetcher).

items.description: One access path, as a `flows` entry writes either side: `ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]`.

writes.description: For `consumes`: `this`, the receiver keeps the arguments (`push`, `set`); a `consumes` row without it keeps nothing (`concat`). For a `keyed` row: the paths whose value becomes the entry under the key (`Argument[1]`, `Argument[1].ReturnValue` an updater's return; for a context, its provider's props: `ReturnValue.Member[Provider].Parameter[0].Member[value]`). For a `cell`: the paths whose value merges into the state, through the handles the call makes or hands its function (`ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]` a setter's argument, `….Parameter[0].ReturnValue` an updater's return, `Argument[0].Parameter[0].Parameter[0]` what a store's `set` receives, `….Parameter[0..]` a store path's keys and value).

items.description: One access path, as a `flows` entry writes either side: `ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]`.

reads.description: For a `keyed` row: the paths that see the entry under the key (`ReturnValue`, `Argument[1].Parameter[0]` an updater's old value). For a `cell`: the paths that see the state (`ReturnValue.Member[0].ReturnValue` a getter's call, `ReturnValue.Member[0]` the value itself, `ReturnValue.Parameter[0].Parameter[0]` a selector's parameter, `ReturnValue.Member[getState].ReturnValue`).

items.description: One access path, as a `flows` entry writes either side: `ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]`.

yields.description: For a `cell`: other moves, as `flows` write them: what a read returns (`ReturnValue.Parameter[0].ReturnValue -> ReturnValue.ReturnValue`), where a dispatch puts its action (`ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0] -> Argument[0].Parameter[1]`), a watched function's result fields.

items.description: `<input> -> <output>`: the value at the input path reaches the output path. An optional ` : test` says the output holds a test of the input (a boolean), not the input. A path is a root (`Argument[n]`, `Argument[n..]`, `Argument[this]`, `ReturnValue`) and then steps (`Parameter[n]`, `Parameter[n..]`, `ReturnValue`, `Member[name]`, `Awaited`, `Awaited[error]`, `ArrayElement`), as CodeQL's models-as-data write them: `Argument[0].Member[queryFn].ReturnValue -> ReturnValue.Member[data]`.

store.description: For a `keyed` row: which store holds the entry. `Argument[this]`: the receiver (`localStorage`, a `QueryClient`), the same store when both receivers name one global or come from one call row (`useQueryClient()`). `providers`: the key is a context object, and a write reaches a read only from a provider above the read in the render tree.

key.description: For a `keyed` row: where the key is (`Argument[0]`, `Argument[0].Member[queryKey]`; `ReturnValue` for the call that makes a context, which is its own key). A constant key (a literal, a `const`, an array of them) joins as proven; any other key joins as assumed.

fallback.description: For a `keyed` row of a `providers` store: the paths a read sees only when no provider is above it (`createContext`'s `Argument[0]`).

items.description: One access path, as a `flows` entry writes either side: `ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]`.

clears.description: For a `keyed` row: the call drops or refreshes the entries under the key (`invalidateQueries`, `removeItem`); it moves no value.

optional.description: For a `cell`: the first argument may be left out (`createResource(fetcher)` has no source); a call that leaves it out has every later argument one place earlier.

state.description: A label: the kind of state a variable this call initializes holds (`const [doc] = createResource(…)` is a `resource`).

scopes.description: A label: the scope role of a function the call is handed at that path (`Argument[1]`: `fetcher`; `query(fn)`: `server`). A `Member[key]` path's key names that role for a function under the key in any object (`queryFn`).

propertyNames.description: One access path, as a `flows` entry writes either side: `ReturnValue.Member[1].Parameter[0]`.

input.description: The call reads the page's URL (`useParams`): where a page's input starts, an `external-read`.

proof.description: The proof kind its relations carry, so existing proof names survive.

note.description: One line for the code map and the proof detail.
